summary: The beis din brings a korban for a mistaken ruling only if they changed a part of a mitzvah. If they said a whole mitzvah is not in the Torah at all, they do not bring a korban.
stIntro: The mishna explains for which type of unwitting transgression based on the ruling of the court there is liability to bring an offering.

words.note: A woman who must wait a clean day before she is tahor again.

chunks.en: one clean day for one day, one is free."
chunks.st: a clean day for a day she experiences a discharge is exempt.
chunks.stMore: When the woman sees a discharge of blood for one or two days during the eleven days between the end of one menstrual period and the expected start of another, the blood is assumed to not be menstrual blood. If after the second day, the next day passes without any discharge of blood, she may immerse immediately and she is ritually pure. The judges ruled erroneously that it is permitted to engage in intercourse with her on the day that she is observing a clean day, even without the day having passed and her having immersed.
